```{r}
cat("Reading broccoli output file.. .\n")
# Read the file with two columns: OG_name and protein_names
broccoli_file <- "/home/data/Ruijie/workplace/broccoli/Anthozoa_genome_fix_plut_ahya/results/Anthozoa_genome_fix_ahya_plut/dir_step4/orthologous_pairs.txt"
df <- read.table(broccoli_file, 
                header = TRUE, 
                sep = "\t", 
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                comment.char = "",
                quote = "")
colnames(df)<- c("in_gene", "out_gene")
cat(sprintf("Read %d orthogroups\n", nrow(df)))
```

```{r}
sps_list <- c("Nvec", "Actieq", "Metsen", "Dialin", "Exapal", 
                "Adig", "Amil", "Gfas", "Gasp", 
                "Spis", "Ocupat", "Ocuarb", "Xesp", 
                "Dgig", "Scocal", "Pdam", "Pcru", "Fspp", 
                "Hcoe", "Amur", "Plut", "Ahya")
# Create a regex pattern from species list
species_pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(sps_list, collapse = "|"), ")_")
# Extract species from protein name
df <- df %>%
mutate(
    species_in = str_extract(in_gene, species_pattern),
    species_in = str_remove(species_in, "_$"),
    species_out = str_extract(out_gene, species_pattern),
    species_out = str_remove(species_out, "_$")
) # Filter to keep only proteins from species in the list

df <- df %>%
mutate(
    # Remove species prefix (e.g., "Spis_")
    temp_name_in = str_remove(in_gene, paste0("^", species_in, "_")),
    temp_name_out = str_remove(out_gene, paste0("^", species_out, "_")),
    # Remove .p1, .p2, etc. suffix
    in_gene = str_remove(temp_name_in, "\\.p\\d+$"),
    out_gene = str_remove(temp_name_out, "\\.p\\d+$")
) %>%
select(-temp_name_in, -temp_name_out)
```

```{r}
gtf_suffix = "_long.annot.gtf"
gtf_dir = "./reference_gtf"
df$in_temp = NA
df$out_temp = NA
# Read all GTF files
for (species in sps_list) {
cat(sprintf("\nReading GTF for %s...\n", species))

gtf_file <- file.path(gtf_dir, paste0(species, gtf_suffix))

if (!file.exists(gtf_file)) {
    warning(sprintf("GTF file not found:  %s", gtf_file))
    next
}

mapping <- rtracklayer::import(gtf_file)
transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(mapping$transcript_id, mapping$gene_id)
df$in_temp[df$species_in == species] <- transcript_to_gene[df$in_gene[df$species_in == species]]
df$out_temp[df$species_out == species] <- transcript_to_gene[df$out_gene[df$species_out == species]]


if (sum(is.na(df$in_temp[df$species_in == species])) == sum(df$species_in == species)){
    message(sprintf("Species %s failed in transcrit, switch to protein", species))
    prot_to_gene<-dic_from_vecs(mapping$protein_id[!is.na(mapping$protein_id)], mapping$gene_id[!is.na(mapping$protein_id)])
    df$in_temp[df$species_in == species] <- prot_to_gene[df$in_gene[df$species_in == species]]
    df$out_temp[df$species_out == species] <- prot_to_gene[df$out_gene[df$species_out == species]]
    }
message(sprintf("Species_in %s: %d total genes", species, sum(df$species_in == species)))
message(sprintf("Species_out %s: %d total genes", species, sum(df$species_out == species)))
message(sprintf("Species_in %s: %d genes unmapped", species, sum(is.na(df$in_temp[df$species_in == species]))))
message(sprintf("Species_out %s: %d genes unmapped", species, sum(is.na(df$out_temp[df$species_out == species]))))
}
```

```{r}
for (species in sps_list){
    message(sprintf("Fixing gene names for species %s", species))
    df$in_gene[df$species_in == species] <- fix_gene_name(df$in_temp[df$species_in == species], paste0(species, "_"))
    df$out_gene[df$species_out == species] <- fix_gene_name(df$out_temp[df$species_out == species], paste0(species, "_"))
}

df_final <- df %>%
    select(in_gene, out_gene)%>%
    distinct(in_gene, out_gene)

write.table(df_final, 
              file = "./Anthozoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_pairs.genes.csv", 
              sep = "\t", 
              row.names = FALSE, 
              quote = FALSE)
```
